lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
He stands where the salt meets the sand,
Watching the gray waves reclaim the land.
A hollow wind whispers through the pines,
Tracing the map of his weary lines.
[Chorus]
Hold the light before the shadows grow,
Where the deep currents pull and flow.
Give me the truth in the crashing tide,
With nowhere left for the heart to hide.
[Verse]
The horizon is a jagged, distant line,
Where the earth and heavy heavens entwine.
One step forward is a mountain's height,
Chasing the ghosts in the fading light.
[Chorus]
Hold the light before the shadows grow,
Where the deep currents pull and flow.
Give me the truth in the crashing tide,
With nowhere left for the heart to hide.
[Bridge]
The storm breaks open, wild and wide,
No more secrets left for him to hide.
[Chorus]
Hold the light before the shadows grow,
Where the deep currents pull and flow.
Give me the truth in the crashing tide,
With nowhere left for the heart to hide.
[Outro]
